title: Tempo, drummers, double time and piano versus banjo
summary: Old drummers kept good time and doubled up with soloists; he names present-day drummers like Giles.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: You were talking about the tempos. You said there's a difference between the bands as far as tempos. What do you mean? Some play slower than others? Yeah. Some bands keep better time and others? Some keep better time. Who are some of the drummers that you think keep good time?
Only them days, I'll tell you the truth, in them days, most all of them, most all of the drummers played good time.
And the banjo players? Did they keep good time too then?

Yeah. Well, did they play a lot of double rap stuff then or would they play a straight four or what? They used to rap a lot. They used to rap a lot. Double. Well, I noticed sometimes, I used to hear you do this a lot more. It seemed like you'd be playing double time on your clarinet. You know what I said? They'd be playing the blues. Yeah. You know what I'm talking about? Yeah, I know what you mean. They used to do that a lot. They used to do that a lot. And when an instrument would do that, when a bandit or a trumpet or anything, when we'd do that, double up that, a good drummer would be right with you. Mm-hmm. I see.

Do you do that much now? I don't do that much now. I don't take the chance to. No. Who are the drummers around sound that you think are good now? Any other good that are left? Oh, yeah. There's a lot of good ones. I think they're all good. If you had a band, who would you hire for the drums?

Oh, well, there's so many of them that I know. There's a couple of drummers that you don't hear and they talk about them. But I think they're real good for Dixieland music. There's Barney Smilton and Albert Giles. Well, I know you worked with Giles and Father Al at one time. Yeah. Up on a magazine or something, I think you don't forget it.
Yeah. If you had a rhythm section that you could pick, would you rather have a piano or a banjo?
Well, I hear one. I take a piano because it would be all support.
Who are the piano players that you like now?
